source_note: Distinguish a person's cultivation from society-wide culture, educational process, isolated facts and a required degree or credential.

source_note: Original three-row/two-column example respects row/column orientation. Queuing suru use does not turn matrix into an unrestricted suru verb.

mapping_note: Reuse existing fishing-industry article; add only the directly sourced N2 level.
source_note: Stable word, reading, title, kanji, exclusions and teaching remain unchanged. Existing 漁/漁業 pair remains reciprocal; angling is not assumed exclusively recreational.

mapping_note: New curved-line article, including a drawn curve and graph curves.
source_note: The stable verb comparison is 曲る, ordinarily written 曲がる; a straight line is a contrast, not a synonym.

mapping_note: New article explicitly teaches discipline/order and the rules or regulations maintaining it.
source_note: Retain the complete 紀律 spelling evidence; do not reduce 規律 to obedience only or equate every organizational rule with national legislation.

mapping_note: New godan cutting-with-a-blade article; not a reuse of existing 切る or 着る.
source_note: Qualify the raw behead/murder gloss by blade use: not every blade killing is beheading and not every killing uses a blade. Combined Daijisen 切る spellings do not freely share every sense.

source_gloss: to be careful,to pay attention,to take care
mapping_note: New careful/pay-attention expression, including internal を, target に and an ichidan final verb.
source_note: Alternate spelling 気をつける is taught. App kango type follows the existing on-first mixed-reading convention, not an all-on compound analysis.

mapping_note: Reuse existing goldfish article; add only directly sourced jlpt 2.
source_note: Preserve the stable identity, primary reading, title, written-kanji array, exclusions and teaching body. This is a scoped source/level check, not a new whole-article recertification.

mapping_note: New article for a delimited area/zone and its extent or limits.
source_note: Account for raw boundary/domain/sphere/territory wording through bounded-area coverage without importing Internet domain names or an exceptionless geographic size rule.

mapping_note: New even-number noun/no-modifier article with correct divisibility and number examples.
source_note: 奇数 is the contrasting category, not a synonymous exclusion. Zero and negative even integers are not excluded from the definition.

mapping_note: New daydream/fantasy article, noun and transitive suru, with imagined lunar life.
source_note: Vision means an imagined scene/prospect, not eyesight. No medical-delusion diagnosis or logical-impossibility rule is inferred.

mapping_note: New spatial in-the-air/midair article retaining the raw sky/air meaning.
source_note: Distinguish aerial position from air as a substance; を can mark a space traversed, not a direct object.

mapping_note: New article positively demonstrates both room air conditioner and portable cooler senses.
source_note: Actual Japanese Daijisen body supports the portable insulated box. An English cooler article does not establish Japanese refrigerator or cocktail senses; cooling emphasis does not prove every device lacks heating.

mapping_note: New nail/fastening-spike article with fastening and hanging examples.
source_note: Retain the missing primary kanji in metadata. Nail-like pachinko pins are included without equating every English pin or bodily nail with 釘.

source_gloss: to punctuate,to cut off,to mark off,to stop,to put an end to
mapping_note: New godan article teaches spatial partition/delimitation and language punctuation/pauses.
source_note: Qualify raw stop/put-an-end-to through a break/stopping point, not an unrestricted finish verb. Kango follows on-first mixed-reading app convention; rare spelling 句切る is not a new pronunciation.

mapping_note: New comb-noun article with tool/action distinction.
source_note: Hair-combing example uses the tool with で; no unsupported 櫛する verb or homophone 串 synonym is taught.

mapping_note: New kana sneeze article, noun and intransitive suru, with くしゃみをする/が出る.
source_note: Sense 2 is restricted to くさめ and not transferred to くしゃみ. Rare kanji spellings remain complete evidence, not promoted as usual writing.

mapping_note: New complaint/grievance noun article; acknowledge the raw troubles gloss with qualified difficult-circumstances coverage.
source_note: Daijisen supplies both complaint and difficult-circumstances definitions; a historical quotation alone does not establish an obsolete or measured-rare label. Do not invent general 苦情する.

mapping_note: New painstaking-effort article with intransitive suru and taskに/Vのに patterns.
source_note: Raw singular pain is interpreted through the actual family pains/effort/trouble and Daijisen accomplishment definition, not silently taught as bodily pain.

mapping_note: New waste/scrap article with usual kana writing and additional person-targeted insulting use.
source_note: Material scraps can retain recycling value; the additional insult is not neutral. Missing 屑 kanji card does not remove the character from metadata.

source_gloss: to destroy,to pull down,to make change (money)
mapping_note: New transitive godan article demonstrates both raw demolition and changing a banknote; disrupted condition is additional teaching.
source_note: 札を崩す preserves equal monetary value; 体調を崩す need not be intentional. Do not mechanically derive every counterpart use.

mapping_note: New ring-finger article identifies it between middle/little fingers; fourth-toe use is explicitly additional.
source_note: Avoid ambiguous English finger numbering and invented naming history; both primary components use native readings.

mapping_note: New intransitive collapse/crumble article with additional lost shape, disordered state and deteriorating weather uses.
source_note: Mark affected subject with が; intransitive does not mean causeless. No fixed severity partition from 荒れる or automatic transfer of all 崩す objects is asserted.
